name: Your own model
description: Any OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint, such as a Whisper server you're running yourself. Each utterance is sent once the VAD marks it finished, so it needs a vad node.

base_url.title: Endpoint
base_url.description: Where your server listens, including the version path.

api_key_env.title: API key variable
api_key_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the key, if your server needs one.

ttfs_p99_latency.title: Final transcript p99 (s)
ttfs_p99_latency.description: How long the pipeline waits after you stop speaking for a late transcript. Set it near your model's real p99: too high adds dead air to every turn.
